note: 0.3.0 shop buildings. Each town (data/towns/*.json "buildings") places walk-in shops on the open-world tile map: wall tiles block, the doorway and floor are walkable, the counter and props block, and a keeper stands behind the counter. Coordinates in the town files are town-local (same grid as "rows"). This file holds per-shop look and talk. The roof covers the footprint except the facade row (the wall with the door) and fades out over roof_fade_s while the player stands on the doorway or inside.

greet: Welcome in! Rope, bait, tools: if it's useful, it's on my shelves.
Mind the sacks. What can I find for you today?
Fair coin for fair goods. Have a look.

helmets.name: Crestwright's Helms
greet: Welcome to Crestwright's Helms. A good head deserves good iron.
Try one on. If it rattles, it's the wrong size.
Every crest hammered right here in town.

body.name: The Mailhouse
greet: The Mailhouse is open. Ring, scale or plate, we fit them all.
Welcome. Arms up, let's see your size.
Light armour or heavy? Either way you'll walk out safer.

legs.name: Greave & Gusset
greet: Greave & Gusset, at your service. Knees are precious.
Welcome! Nobody runs far on bruised shins.
Step up. Greaves, leg plates, buckles all included.

shields.name: Bossmaker's Shields
greet: Bossmaker's Shields. Better it hits the board than you.
Welcome. Rim, boss and grip, all sound, I promise.
A shield's the friend that never runs. Browse away.

swords.name: Edgewell Blades
greet: Welcome to Edgewell Blades. Sharp steel, fair prices.
Daggers for the quick, swords for the steady. Have a look.
Mind your fingers near the racks.

axes.name: Cleft & Haft
greet: Cleft & Haft. Big swings for big folk.
Welcome. Every head is balanced on its haft by hand.
Looking for something that splits more than logs?

maces.name: Flange & Knob
greet: Flange & Knob. When plate won't cut, crush it.
Welcome! Maces, hammers, the honest kind of weapon.
Heavy stock today. Lift with your legs.

archery.name: Fletch & Stave
greet: Fletch & Stave. Straight shafts, true staves.
Welcome, archer. Arrows by the bundle, bows by the hand.
Keep your distance from trouble. Buy a bow.

player.name: Empty shop
greet: This shop's for sale. Fifteen hundred marks and the keys are yours.
Good bones, this place. Shelves, counter, a till that locks.
Thinking of selling to the town? Start here.

cook.name: Cook House
greet: Hot from the oven, and cheaper than the general store.
Sit yourself down. Carp, eel, rat or chicken — all cooked.
Mind the ovens. Buy a meal or cook your own catch.

owned_greet: Morning, boss. The till's been busy.
Welcome back. I kept the stands dusted.

smithy.name: Blacksmith
enter_greet: Mind the sparks. Furnace is hot and the anvil's free, help yourself.
Come in, come in. Bars go in the furnace, blades come off the anvil.
Forge is lit. Smelt what you like; the counter's open if you'd rather buy.

cookhouse.name: Cook House
enter_greet: Smell that? Oven's hot. Cook your own or buy a plate.
Come in, come in. Food's cheap and the fire's free.
Hungry? The counter sells cooked meals; the ovens are for guests.
